answer: Operator-Scoped Revocation Ledger: each agent wallet signs sessions through a certified relay tied to a persistent operator ID. Graph clustering flags sybil clusters; one verified pearl of collusion triggers action against the operator—not wallets: relay cert revoked for a 90-day horizon, pending settlement frozen, and new wallet admissions blocked. Attacker forfeits accumulated fees, rebuilds infrastructure, and crosses a re-certification canyon (audit plus delay), making each sybil cluster cost the operator its revenue channel.
